svg.title: Featured projects: CVE Copilot, Chest X-Ray Pneumonia Detection, Reliability-Aware AutoML, Telco Churn Prediction
svg.text: LLM assistant that turns raw CVE advisories into JSON
briefs and severity calls, scored against real NVD
ratings on a frozen 16-CVE eval set.
Scores data quality on 5 dimensions, spreads row
trust through a similarity graph, then trains on
customers, from EDA to a tuned pipeline served in
